question: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.
final_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT r.name FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.raceId ASC LIMIT 1) AS race_name FROM drivers AS d ORDER BY d.dob DESC, d.driverId ASC LIMIT 1

question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player? Output either 'highest' or 'shortest' as the answer.
final_sql: WITH highest_player AS (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1), shortest_player AS (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY height ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT AVG(finishing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM highest_player)) >= (SELECT AVG(finishing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM shortest_player)) THEN 'highest' ELSE 'shortest' END AS answer;

final_sql: SELECT AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_up_votes, AVG(u.Age) AS avg_user_age FROM users AS u INNER JOIN ( SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ) AS p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId

question: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
final_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.DisplayName, p.OwnerDisplayName) = 'Mornington' THEN COALESCE(p.ViewCount, 0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.DisplayName, p.OwnerDisplayName) = 'Amos' THEN COALESCE(p.ViewCount, 0) ELSE 0 END) FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

question: Between DC and Marvel Comics, which publisher has published more superheroes? Find the difference in the number of superheroes they have published.
final_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN dc_count >= marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Marvel Comics' END AS publisher_name, ABS(dc_count - marvel_count) AS difference FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count FROM superhero AS s JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics'));

question: How much faster in percentage is the champion than the driver who finished all laps of the race last in the 1988 Australian Grand Prix?
final_sql: WITH race AS (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 1988 AND name LIKE '%Australian Grand Prix%' LIMIT 1), winner AS (SELECT milliseconds AS ms FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race) AND position = 1 AND milliseconds IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1), last_driver AS (SELECT milliseconds AS ms FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race) AND laps = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race)) AND milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CAST((last_driver.ms - winner.ms) AS REAL) * 100.0 / last_driver.ms FROM winner, last_driver;

question: Please calculate the race completion percentage (all laps completed) for Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009.
final_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN res.laps = tl.total_laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN (SELECT raceId, MAX(lap) AS total_laps FROM lapTimes GROUP BY raceId) AS tl ON res.raceId = tl.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
